newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices flat to lower Wed.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices flat to lower Wed.

text.p: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices were flat to lower overnight Wednesday, amid thin dealing, brokers said.

The daytime market failed to sustain the advances made late Tuesday after the American Petroleum Institute (API) reported crude stocks fell a sharp 7.6 million barrels last week, bringing total U.S. stocks to 297.8 million.
At 1627 PST Wednesday, NYMEX April crude was unchanged from the settle at $20.42 a barrel, as 336 lots traded.
Traders said April crude could fall further if it dips under $20 Thursday. Key support was seen at $19.95.
Heating oil futures for April were flat at 52.50 cents a gallon, traders said, with a thin 69 lots exchanged.
NYMEX gasoline on ACCESS traded 63.20 cents, off 0.13 cents a gallon from a settle, with a volume of 12 lots traded.
